_comment: A cooling-off set in days counts from the day the wish was added. The server resolves `cooling_until` from `added_on` + `days` (backend/tests/unit/test_wishlist_reach.py runs these against `guide.wishlist.cooling_until_for`); the edit form previews the same date while the person types, and reads a stored date back as days (frontend/src/components/guide/wishlist/wishlistCooling.test.ts). Both directions must agree across month, year and leap-day edges, or the form shows one date and saves another.

cases.note: zero days ends the day it was added
across a US daylight-saving change, where a day is 23 hours
